title: Project Sidekick directed-energy weapon

tellings.quote: but then there's also project sidekick which is a weapon.

plain: In the 1980s, at a secret site in the Nevada desert known as S4, there was a project called Sidekick, and it was a weapon, said to be one that fires a beam of energy. That is the claim of Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked at S4 himself. He mentions it only in passing, as "project sidekick which is a weapon", next to the other work he describes there.
